blocks.text: 144 מוּסַף לְיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה 144

אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ תְּקַע בְּשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל לְחֵרוּתֵנוּ וְשָׂא נֵס לְקַבֵּץ גָּלֻיּוֹתֵינוּ וְקָרֵב פְּזוּרֵינוּ מִבֵּין הַגּוֹיִם וּנְפוּצוֹתֵינוּ כַּנֵּס מִיַּרְכְּתֵי אָרֶץ וַהֲבִיאֵנוּ לְצִיּוֹן עִירְךָ בְּרִנָּה וְלִירוּשָׁלַיִם בֵּית מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּשִׂמְחַת עוֹלָם וְשָׁם נַעֲשֶׂה לְפָנֶיךָ אֶת קָרְבְּנוֹת חוֹבוֹתֵינוּ כְּמִצְוָה (נ״א כִּמְצֻוָּה) עָלֵינוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ מִפִּי כְבוֹדֶךָ כָּאָמוּר: וּבְי֨וֹם שִׂמְחַתְכֶ֣ם וּֽבְמוֹעֲדֵיכֶם֮ וּבְרָאשֵׁ֣י חָדְשֵׁכֶם֒ וּתְקַעְתֶּ֣ם בַּחֲצֹֽצְרֹ֗ת עַ֚ל עֹלֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעַ֖ל זִבְחֵ֣י שַׁלְמֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָי֨וּ לָכֶ֤ם לְזִכָּרוֹן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲנִ֖י יְיָ֥ אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם: כִּי אַתָּה שׁוֹמֵעַ קוֹל שׁוֹפָר וּמַאֲזִין תְּרוּעָה וְאֵין דּוֹמֶה לָּךְ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ שׁוֹמֵעַ קוֹל תְּרוּעַת עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרַחֲמִים:
uncertainties: Num 10:10 accent and host letter inventory, read from s308-pair04 (lines 07–08) and s308-pair05 (line 09). Each item is word, accent, host letter, then confidence. (1) וּבְי֨וֹם: qadma U+05A8 on yod. LOW: I could not clearly see a mark above this word. (2) שִׂמְחַתְכֶ֣ם: munah U+05A3 on kaf. MEDIUM: an L-shaped mark below; merkha is not excluded. (3) וּֽבְמוֹעֲדֵיכֶם֮: meteg U+05BD on the shuruq vav, and zarqa U+05AE after the final mem. The zarqa squiggle is clear. (4) וּבְרָאשֵׁ֣י: munah U+05A3 on shin. (5) חָדְשֵׁכֶם֒: segolta U+0592 after the final mem. Clear. (6) וּתְקַעְתֶּ֣ם: munah U+05A3 on tav. (7) בַּחֲצֹֽצְרֹ֗ת: meteg U+05BD on the first tsadi, rebia U+0597 on resh. (8) עַ֚ל: yetiv U+059A on ayin. Its '<' shape stands before the word. (9) עֹלֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם: munah U+05A3 on the second lamed, zaqef qatan U+0594 on kaf. (10) וְעַ֖ל: tipcha U+0596 on ayin. (11) זִבְחֵ֣י: munah U+05A3 on het. (12) שַׁלְמֵיכֶ֑ם: etnachta U+0591 on kaf. Clear '^' shape. (13) וְהָי֨וּ: qadma U+05A8 on yod. (14) לָכֶ֤ם: mahpakh U+05A4 on kaf. MEDIUM. (15) לְזִכָּרוֹן֙: pashta U+0599 after the final nun. Clear. (16) לִפְנֵ֣י: munah U+05A3 on nun. (17) אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם: meteg U+05BD on lamed, zaqef qatan U+0594 on kaf. The meteg is MEDIUM. (18) אֲנִ֖י: tipcha U+0596 on nun. (19) יְיָ֥: merkha U+05A5 on the second yod. MEDIUM. (20) אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם: silluq U+05BD on kaf, followed by sof pasuq ':'.
כמצוה variant marker and pointing: already a pending human question. I left the draft text unchanged.
וְלִירוּשָׁלַיִם: the yod is printed in the image, so no CGJ. The 308/310 Jerusalem item is already pending.
לָּךְ: I cannot confirm a dagesh dot inside the lamed at this resolution. I kept the draft reading and raised a human question.
אָרֶץ: the vowel under the aleph looks qamats, but the marks below it are smudged.
Printed in an unpointed semi-cursive (vaybertaytsh-style) face. The aleph in אין is that face's aleph shape, not an aleph-lamed ligature.
Large unpointed call names. The colons are printed as diamond dots.

blocks.text: הַיּוֹם הֲרַת עוֹלָם. הַיּוֹם יַעֲמִיד בַּמִּשְׁפָּט. כָּל יְצוּרֵי עוֹלָמִים. אִם כְּבָנִים. אִם כַּעֲבָדִים. אִם כְּבָנִים רַחֲמֵנוּ כְּרַחֵם אָב עַל בָּנִים. וְאִם כַּעֲבָדִים עֵינֵינוּ לְךָ תְלוּיוֹת. עַד שֶׁתְּחָנֵּנוּ וְתוֹצִיא כָאוֹר מִשְׁפָּטֵנוּ אָיוֹם קָדוֹשׁ:
uncertainties: יַעֲמִיד: there may be a small meteg under the yod. Not certain, so not patched. Human question raised.
תְלוּיוֹת: this font's tav may hide a dagesh dot. I kept the draft reading (no dagesh).
Printed small, inside the parenthesis before זִכְרוֹן. Kept as אַם שַׁבָּת, the form humans confirmed on earlier pages.

blocks.text: אֲרֶשֶׁת שְׂפָתֵינוּ יֶעֱרַב לְפָנֶיךָ אֵל רָם וְנִשָּׂא. מֵבִין וּמַאֲזִין מַבִּיט וּמַקְשִׁיב לְקוֹל (זִכְרוֹן) תְּקִיעָתֵנוּ וּתְקַבֵּל בְּרַחֲמִים וּבְרָצוֹן סֵדֶר שׁוֹפְרוֹתֵינוּ:
uncertainties: The source reads (אַם שבת. זִכְרוֹן). The rubric is split out into areshet_shabbat_rubric and role_labels.

blocks.text: רְצֵה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִתְפִלָּתָם. וְהָשֵׁב אֶת הָעֲבוֹדָה לִדְבִיר בֵּיתֶךָ וְאִשֵּׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּתְפִלָּתָם בְּאַהֲבָה תְקַבֵּל בְּרָצוֹן וּתְהִי לְרָצוֹן תָּמִיד עֲבוֹדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ.
uncertainties: A pashta-like mark is printed at the top left of אֶת (line 22). It is not encoded pending a human decision on whether it is a deliberate accent.
תְקַבֵּל (line 23): the tav may carry a dot. I can't decide this at this resolution. Human question raised.

blocks.text: Our God and God of our fathers, blow the great Shofar for our freedom and raise a banner for the gathering of our exiles and bring near our dispersed ones from the corners of the earth and bring us to Zion Thy city in mirth and to Jerusalem Thy sanctuary in eternal joy and there we will perform before Thee our sacrificial obligations according to the commandment given to us in Thy Torah through Thy servant Moses from the mouth of Thy glory as it is said: ‘and on the day of your rejoicing and on your festivals and on your new moons, you shall blow trumpets over your whole-offerings and over the sacrifices of your peace-offerings and they shall be a reminder on your behalf before your God, I am the Lord your God’. For Thou dost hear the sound of the Shofar and listen to Teruah and there is none like Thee. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who hearest the Teruah sound of His people Israel in compassion.
uncertainties: The Hebrew cue א״וא before the first word is excluded as a linkage cue.

blocks.text: The Shofar is blown (but not on the Sabbath).

On this day the world was completed. On this day He brings to judgment all the world’s creatures, either like children or like slaves. If like children, then have mercy upon us as a father has mercy on children. If like slaves, then our eyes are lifted to Thee until Thou wilt be gracious to us and make our verdict shine forth like light, O Awe-inspiring and Holy One.
uncertainties: The source hyphenates 'chil-dren' at a line break; joined here. The cue היום is excluded.

blocks.text: May the utterance of our lips be pleasing before Thee, O lofty and exalted God, who understands and listens, pays heed and hearkens to the sound of (the memory of) our Tekioth. Mayest Thou accept with compassion and favour the order of our Shofaroth.

Take delight, O Lord our God, in Thy people Israel and in their prayer and restore the service to the sanctuary of Thy House and accept with love and favour the fire offerings of Israel and their prayer, and may the service of Thy people Israel be a perpetual delight.

verdict: NOT APPROVED. I read all 13 images. The English on 309 matches the draft exactly, including punctuation. On 308 the draft omits all Num 10:10 cantillation; the patch above restores it. Some accent identities and dagesh/meteg points are too small to settle at this enlargement and are open as human questions, so all_hebrew_words_and_marks_checked is false. I added no questions that duplicate the already-pending 308 items (Jerusalem, כמצוה variant).
